domain: Real-Time Data Monitoring and Performance Analysis for High-Performance Computing Systems
scenario:
A technology company is developing an enterprise-level performance monitoring platform for high-performance computing (HPC) systems. This platform is designed to collect, analyze, and visualize real-time data from various system components such as CPUs, memory, network, and storage devices. The platform aims to enhance system performance, optimize resource utilization, and ensure efficient operation of large-scale data centers.

The system should capture detailed metrics at regular intervals, such as CPU usage, memory utilization, network throughput, and storage performance. It needs to provide insights into the health and performance of each component, support predictive analytics to forecast potential bottlenecks, and provide alerts for system anomalies or resource exhaustion.

The platform should enable administrators to configure threshold-based alerts, generate performance reports, and conduct historical data analysis for trend identification. Additionally, it must support scalability to accommodate growing data volumes and integrate seamlessly with existing data center infrastructure. This includes advanced user roles and permissions to manage access and editing rights, ensuring that data integrity and security are maintained across the platform.
